definition.def: If you specify something, you give information about what is required or should happen in a certain situation.
examples: They specified a spacious entrance hall. [VERB noun]
He has not specified what action he would like them to take. [VERB wh]

definition.def: If you specify what should happen or be done, you explain it in an exact and detailed way.
examples: Each recipe specifies the size of egg to be used. [VERB noun]
One rule specifies that learner drivers must be supervised by adults. [VERB that]
Patients eat together at a specified time. [VERB-ed]

examples.sentence: But the more powerful AI becomes, the more important it will be to specify its goals with great care.
Yes, and it's got to be practical, so don't forget to specify things like who would be involved.
